notes.title: Play the FULL GAME for FREE!

[h2]FULL GAME Playtest[/h2][p]We've been hard at work to make [b]17.waves[/b] the best it can be! The next step is for us to put the game in the public's hands to get their honest opinions. While debating what content would be best to include in this playtest, we decided, "Why not ALL of it?!"[/p][p][/p][p]From [b]today until September 15th [/b]you can [u]play 17.waves in its entirety[/u], with full online multiplayer support! This is made available through a Public Playtest here on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h2]How to Join[/h2][p]Anyone who had previously registered for the playtest will now automatically be granted access. Just a screenshot so you know what to look out for[/i])[/p][p][/p][h2]Feedback[/h2][p]While you have no obligation, our primary goal here is to engage you all, and gather up as much feedback as can heading to a final release. If we could ask on more favour of you, it'd be that you please add [b]17.waves [/b]to your [u]Wishlist[/u]!

notes.title: Upcoming Playtest Announcement
notes.content: [h2]Upcoming Playtest[/h2][p]17.waves TD has been tested privately for many months already, and we feel it's ready to be in the public's hands! The next step is to get it in your hands to really put it to the test. A huge thank you to [url="https://www.alphabetagamer.com/17-waves-beta-sign-up/"]AlphaBetaGamer[/url] for helping promote this playtest.[/p][p]A co-op multiplayer game is going to be a little different with every new group of friends, and we want to be sure the experience is fun and smooth across as many groups as possible - even when Robbie forgets to charge your last line of defense, or Anne miss her toss and chucks gold off a cliff for the 12th time today. [b]Your feedback is everything![/b][/p][p]We want to hear from you to make the game the best it can be![/p][p][/p][h2]How to Join[/h2][p]On the main Steam page, just below the screenshot carousel there is a pair of links.[/p][olist][*][p]The [b]17.waves Demo[/b]. notes.title: Feedback Update - 2025-02
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest
In preparation for Steam Next Fest, we've given the 17.waves a standalone demo page. Your feedback thus far has been invaluable, and we wanted to grant you additional ways to share your thoughts on the demo.

You can check out the updated demo here, with space to directly leave reviews on that new page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2383570/17waves_TD_Demo/

[h1]Thank you![/h1]

Thank you for all the great feedback so far! This patch includes a bunch of updates addressing a number of points people have made. Try them out now on the demo build!

[h3]Tower Upgrades[/h3]
Towers now need a differing amount of Hex Nuts depending on the team size. Fewer Players equals Fewer Hex Nuts.

[h3]Coin Cache Attraction[/h3]
The Coin Cache Attraction radius has been increased from 2 to 3 meters. With DeadEye the attraction has been increased from 6 to 12 meters.

[h3]High score[/h3]
A "High score" has been added to the Overworld view. This is the amount of coins unspent at the end of each level. It has no effect on anything, just for your own information.

[h3]Enemy Coin Drops[/h3]
When an Enemy hits your base, they will now still drop coins.

[h3]Various Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Player under glow to help visibility
[*]Player drop shadow to help landing when jumping/flying with Fleet-Foot/Littlewing
[*]Hide full player names in Loading Screen and Score Cards when "Player Nameplate" is disabled
[*]Increase Overclock damage and recharge speed
[*]More Balancing updates regarding Enemy health and counts for differing team sizes
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with Littlewing not brining Player back to nearest tower when died
[*]Fixed issue with enemy collisions were not hitting all Players if the host purchased Littlewing
[*]Fixed issue with Projectiles not being removed when a Tower is destroyed
[*]Fixed issue with Boosted/Flame audio still playing when a Tower is destroyed
[*]Fixed issue with "Use/Deposit" text not being removed after using an item
[/list]

notes.title: Publisher + Artist Get!
notes.content:
[h3]PUBLISHER[/h3]
Hello all! This is Graeme from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/2leftthumbs]2 Left Thumbs[/url]. I'm thrilled to announce that I'll be stepping in as Publisher for [b]17.waves[/b]!! Some of my best memories playing games have been in party-games with friends. Bottling that hilarity up with tower defense gameplay was something that immediately drew me in!

My specialize in publishing has been in working with small, indie teams. But an online multiplayer game is new territory for me. I'm hopeful I can bring a new audience to 17.waves, and make it a staple of your party games nights!

[h3]ARTIST[/h3]
While we're at it, the very talented artist [url=https://www.instagram.com/liamcrossieart/]Liam Crossie[/url] (follow his Insta!) has been brought in to give the game a major facelift! While the more minimal, polygonal look and feel of the game will be maintained, Liam is taking things to the [b]next level[/b]!!

notes.title: Ring Toss!
notes.content:
Feeling Lucky?

Hex Nuts and Canisters can now be tossed directly into Towers. An item must be tossed into the Tower ring so it ain't easy though!

notes.title: Assist Droid!
notes.content:
[h2]Assist Droid[/h2]

New Assist Droid to help out with tasks when playing solo, or just because you like the little guy!

Every player can enable/disable their own droid at any time. The droid has three modes:
[list]
[*]  Upgrade: Mine and use fasteners on the closest Tower
[*]  Replenish: Mine and use canisters on the Tower with the least charge
[*]  Deposit: Collect coins and deposit in the caches
[/list]

Players each control their own droid by pressing Right Bumper on Gamepad or "T" (for Target) on Keyboard.


[h2]Balance Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*]  Arrow tower damage per level updated
[*]  Mine cost decreased to 4
[*]  Boost now does a small amount of damage in addition to Radius and Recharge Speed increase
[/list]

If you experience any issues please feel free to leave a comment here or on our discord!

Cheers!

notes.title: Camera Lock Setting
notes.content:
Some players have experienced nausea from the camera aiming at the player.

I've added a setting in Visuals > Lock Camera

Which will follow the player at a set distance instead. Hope this helps, but please let me know if there's something else that can be improved.

Cheers!

notes.title: LAN Support
notes.content:
Experimental LAN Support is now provided

In the settings menu you can change "Relay" connection setting to "LAN"

Both the host and clients will need to set the connection setting.
The join code will be the local host IP Address, which the clients will input.

Host will need to make sure no firewalls are set, and their computer is discoverable on the network.

If you have any issues or have any tips for others, please reply here.

Cheers!

notes.title: Speed Update
notes.content:
Prevailing feedback was that the game was a bit too slow. I've updated the speed of most gameplay elements.


[list]
[*] Increased enemy speed
[*] Increased tower rate of fire
[*] Increased resource replenishment rate
[*] Increased player movement speed
[/list]

I've tested some, but more feedback on the new speed of things is always welcome.
